_comment: Minigames (0.15.0, systems.md 5.5): short optional games that pay for active play. A game has a KIND (the rules: how a round is planned and scored, one PHP scorer + one client screen each) and is used by a TARGET (what it's played on and what it pays: 'station' pays extra raws today; 'craft' is the later Focus bonus). Each guild's station picks its kind and its look (skin, words) in professions.json -> station.minigame, and may override any of the kind's params there. tiredness: every finished round adds 1 to the player's tiredness, which halves every recovery_half_life_hours x pace; a round pays (1 - drop_per_round)^tiredness of full, never below floor. Every number here is [tune].

station._comment: A perfect, fresh round pays reward_minutes of the station's first raw (at its current rate, after pace and bottega level). A round scoring find_at_score or better also finds find_units of the rarest raw the player has unlocked (or more of the first raw, before any other is unlocked); tiredness scales both.

strike._comment: A marker sweeps back and forth along a bar; tap while it's over the sweet spot. Each swing: speed in bar-lengths per second (random between speed_min and speed_max, then x (1 + ramp_per_swing x swing number)), a random start (phase 0-2) and a random sweet-spot centre. good_width and perfect_width are the whole width of each zone. No tap within swing_timeout_ms is a miss; gap_ms is the pause between swings. A round can't be finished faster than its taps, timeouts and gaps add up to.
